description: Adoption paperwork, interview notes, and animal-specific restrictions are drifting apart across different staff members, and the shelter needs a consistent basis for evaluating fit.

user_profile.persona: 40-year-old adoption manager overseeing several staff reviewers
user_profile.context: The shelter wants fair adoption decisions, but inconsistent notes are making applications harder to compare
user_profile.communication_style: Consistency-driven and careful, wants one aligned view of each application and animal profile

fact_sheet.fact: Sarah Jenkins is the Adoption Manager at Pawsitive Beginnings Animal Rescue, overseeing a team of four reviewers.
Liam Chen, an Adoption Reviewer, has been on staff since March 5, 2021.
Maria Garcia is a part-time Adoption Reviewer who works Wednesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
The shelter's official management software is 'ShelterSync', accessible at the URL https://pawsitivebeginnings.sheltersync.com.
Sarah Jenkins's user ID for ShelterSync is 'sjenkins-mgr', and her workstation is Desk #1 in the main office.
Prior to June 1, 2024, adoption interview notes were stored in a shared Google Drive folder named 'Adoption_Interviews_Archive'.
A new policy, effective June 1, 2024, mandates all adoption notes be entered directly into the 'Interview Notes' tab in ShelterSync.
The 'Unified Adoption Profile' (UAP) standard requires a 'Behavioral Fit Score' from 1 to 5 to be assigned to each application.
Any application with a Behavioral Fit Score below 3 requires a secondary review and signature from Sarah Jenkins.
A mandatory adoption review meeting is held every Tuesday at 10:00 AM in the main conference room to discuss pending applications.
The standard adoption application form is document #PB-ADOPT-004-REV3.
Liam Chen conducted an interview with the Miller family for application APP-9012 on June 16, 2024, at 2:00 PM.
Maria Garcia performed a home visit for applicant Johnathan Davis (APP-9013) on June 20, 2024, and uploaded the report to ShelterSync the same day.
The animal with ID D-4815 is a 3-year-old male Beagle mix named 'Buster'.
Buster's profile in ShelterSync has a mandatory restriction tag: 'NO_CATS'.
The animal with ID C-1623 is a 5-year-old female Siamese cat named 'Luna'.
Luna has a medical restriction requiring a diabetic-specific diet of Purina Pro Plan DM Savory Selects, fed 1/2 can twice daily.
Luna's behavioral profile specifies she needs a 'QUIET_HOME_ONLY' with no children under the age of 16.
A German Shepherd named Rocky (ID D-4816) requires a home with a physical fence at least 6 feet high.
The Miller family, application ID APP-9012, applied to adopt Buster on June 15, 2024.
Liam Chen's original notes for application APP-9012, found in his personal Google Doc, state the Miller family owns two cats.
Johnathan Davis, application ID APP-9013, applied to adopt Luna on June 18, 2024.
Maria Garcia's official home visit report for Johnathan Davis confirms he lives alone in a 750 sq ft apartment with no other pets.
The application fee for all dog and cat adoptions at Pawsitive Beginnings Animal Rescue is $150.
The weekly data backup for ShelterSync runs every Sunday at 2:00 AM and is managed by IT contractor 'Maple Creek Tech Solutions'.
